description: Normative semantic obligations and executed schema-only shape cases for local message authoring, one immutable binding and peer full-set Consent. Placeholder identifiers/proofs are schema examples, not cryptographic or production acceptance evidence. Reference model tests exercise CAS, MIMI diff and exact replay only; real PG/HTTP/MLS/cold recovery remains downstream. Direct governance cases are a bounded policy reference only, not signature, SQL or production acceptance evidence.

cases.action: Remove voice only, preserve the complete presence entry and optional-member presence.
assertions: Remove voice only, preserve the complete presence entry and optional-member presence.
